Shah Rukh Khan Tops List of Richest Indian Actors Amid Net Worth Drop

Shah Rukh Khan has been named the richest Indian actor with a net worth of ₹10,000 crore, according to the Hurun India Rich List 2026. Despite retaining his top position, his net worth saw a significant decrease of ₹2,490 crore compared to the previous year. Salman Khan also featured on the list of richest actors.
